definitions.explanation: One's own house or home, often with affection.

examples.japanese: {我|わ}が{家|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧。
{我|わ}が{家|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧。
{我|わ}が{家|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦ほっとする→ほっとする：07652_hottosuru⟧。
examples.english: When I come home, I feel relieved.
Flowers bloom in our garden every spring.

notes:
{我|わ}が{家|や} means "my/our home" with a sense of affection.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {我|わ}が{家|や}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧ (return home)
- {我|わ}が{家|や}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一番|いちばん}→一番：01140_ichiban⟧ (there's no place like home)
- {我|わ}が{家|や}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜 (our family's ~)
{我|わ}が is a classical possessive form. This pattern appears in set expressions:
- {我|わ}が⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧ (our country)
- {我|わ}が⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧ (my child)
- {我|わ}が⟦{社|しゃ}→〜社：04660_sha⟧ (our company)

Note: {我|わ}が is literary/formal. Casual: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧, ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧
